o.text: Uncertain. Possibly cognate with Turkish partal (“worn-out”), from Persian پرتل (“pack, bundle, packet”), in which case derived through metathesis.

From Old Anatolian Turkish داخی (daxï, daqï, d̥aqï), from Proto-Oghuz *takï, from Proto-Turkic *tak- (“to bind to, add to”). Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (taqï), Turkish dahi (“also, too”), etc.

From cizmək (an old variant of cızmaq) + -gi.
Alternatively, a borrowing from Ottoman Turkish چزگی (whence Turkish çizgi) with the onset voicing due the influence of cızmaq.
